name: FAST action tokenizer
summary: Naive per-dimension binning of high-frequency actions produces long, highly redundant token sequences that autoregressive VLAs learn poorly. FAST applies a discrete cosine transform to the action chunk and byte-pair-encodes the coefficients, yielding much shorter token strings. A universal tokenizer trained on a million trajectories works across robots off the shelf, letting an autoregressive pi-0-FAST match diffusion-based pi-0 with substantially less training compute.
innovation: Frequency-domain compression of action sequences before discretization.
A universal, robot-agnostic action tokenizer released for reuse.
matters: Removed the main technical objection to autoregressive rather than diffusion VLAs.
limits: Autoregressive decoding remains slower at inference than a single flow-matching pass.
lineage: An action representation designed for pi-0-class models, replacing uniform binning.
